Phone target: retain image 1's PORTRAIT layout: top Fretwave bar, two-line title, two dropdowns, local tabs, exercise section, horizontal 01–05 selector, compact tab preview, tempo and mode, microphone row, landscape instruction, large Démarrer button, accordage row and four-item bottom navigation.
